title: Add bounded dynamic uncertainty expansion over cached embeddings

properties: raw measurements and thresholds are explicitly uncalibrated
each absent signal has an exact unavailable reason
unavailable evidence never triggers expansion by itself
observed, unavailable and triggered signal sets are complete and canonical
signal and selection policy species-margin thresholds must agree
the complete evidence row and policy are semantically fingerprinted

semantics: the API accepts no encoder and no embedding-vector payload
query embedding fingerprint remains identical across replacement plans
every retained and added reference embedding identity exists in the pinned reference geography index
all prior reference memberships survive immutable replacement
new membership rounds receive new pool and plan fingerprints
cache reuse records zero encoder invocations and false vector materialization

controls: mandatory target and complete safety-union eligibility
mandatory rescore boundary after each applied round
properties: every decision binds prior and replacement plan identities, evidence and both policies
added candidate, reference media, observation and embedding identities remain explicit
candidate counts prove the configured per-candidate increment
stopped decisions contain no replacement identity or added references
no expansion decision authorizes production release
